Oh My Mahjong · launches Nov 11

Juniper, matched by Claude

My own picks for Juniper, start to finish, before any swipe book. Twelve mats in four groups, each with two racks. Tap any card to zoom.

How I read Juniper: a deep, fairly clean forest green back (a jewel tone, not olive), with bright chartreuse and jade layers and white faces. The faces that fill the table are pink and coral craks, kelly and mint bams, and pink, teal and navy dots. So the top mats need a deep or kelly green and pink. A mat with only green matches the back but won't be a top match.

Made for each other

Left out, and why

  • Esme (Oh My Mahjong): your pick for Emerald and a perfect fit, but it's no longer on Oh My Mahjong's site.
  • Lorelei (Oh My Mahjong): pagodas and pink, but it's led by bright aqua blue.
  • Midnight Peacock (Anders Ruff): right deep green, but gold instead of pink.
  • Flora and Aria (Britt Mills): pretty pinks, no green ground to hold the backs.
